name: s2-lint-oktext
final_text:
The question went through on the second attempt.

**First call was rejected** by the lint layer, not by the operator. Three violations in my prompt: two em-dashes, one contraction (`can't`), and a 25-word sentence against a 20-word cap.

**Second call was accepted.** The prompt I sent:

> curia limits how many times an agent may rewrite a message that was rejected. Which cap should we use?
>
> Option A is a cap of 3. This ends a stuck loop sooner. An agent that cannot fix its text fails fast instead of burning turns.
>
> Option B is a cap of 5. This gives the agent more room to fix its own text before the attempt is abandoned.
>
> Which do you want: 3 or 5?

**What the tool said back, verbatim:** `ACCEPTED. The human reads it now.`

So the tool confirmed delivery but returned no answer — the operator has not chosen between 3 and 5 yet. If you want the decision itself, the tool call needs to be made again once they have responded, or I can re-ask.
